name: avatar-onboarding-fragment
description: Capture a reference photo into the active profile root, register it as the reference photo (<profileRoot>/avatar.png, identity avatar_path), then generate a stylised expression set (neutral/joy/thinking/listening/speaking/mouth_open) from it into <profileRoot>/avatar/draft. The displayed avatar is not changed: adopting the draft is a separate, explicit step (concierge Settings > Voice > avatar > "Use this avatar").

context.purpose: Reusable avatar creation flow with bridge-selectable image generation and profile registration.
context.required_inputs: identity_path, profile_name, profile_language, interaction_style, bridge_preference, avatar_style, consent_provider, consent_granted_by (capture_output_path / avatar_output_dir: empty = active profile root defaults)
context.failure_modes: camera unavailable, host bridge hand-off (exit 100, rerun after the host saves the frames), missing per-run consent for a cloud or host-bridge provider, avatar generation failure, identity write failure
context.consent_note: Cloud and host-bridge providers receive the photo only with a per-run consent: pass --context {"consent_provider":"<provider id>","consent_granted_by":"<who>"}. Empty = local providers only.
context.path_note: Empty capture_output_path = <profileRoot>/tmp/avatar-capture.jpg (personal tier; moved to <profileRoot>/avatar.png by register_avatar and deleted on success and failure). Empty avatar_output_dir = <profileRoot>/avatar/draft (the generator default). The reference photo and the generated set stay separate; the stylised neutral frame never overwrites avatar.png.
context.adoption_note: The generated set waits in <profileRoot>/avatar/draft until adopted with concierge Settings > Voice > avatar > "Use this avatar" (setup action avatar_use), which promotes it to <profileRoot>/avatar and points identity avatar_profile at it.

params.message: 🏁 Avatar onboarding complete. Reference photo registered as avatar.png in the active profile; the generated set waits in avatar/draft until you choose "Use this avatar" in concierge settings.
